command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state; echo '=== package ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path --user 0 moe.shizuku.privileged.api; echo '=== current focus ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys window | grep -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' | head -n 6 || true; echo '=== shizuku processes ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,UID,PID,NAME | grep -Ei 'shizuku|rikka' || true; echo '=== shizuku ui ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/window.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/window.xml 2>/dev/null | tr '<' '
<' | grep -Ei 'Shizuku|running|not running|Start|USB debugging|Wireless debugging|service' | head -n 120 || true; echo phase2c_shizuku_server_check_complete=true
